title: Restore the xtask binary build and parse Windows gate logs on Linux
goal: The xtask binary compiles again on origin/main: declare the receipt-verification modules gate_receipt.rs already uses (test_binary_evidence, test_runner, native_provenance, added by 5607cc09d without the declarations). Fix gate_receipt's cwd-relative harness prefix, which used Path::strip_prefix and so never matched a Windows-recorded target directory on a Linux host.
limitations: xtask/tests/native_push_policy.rs still fails strict clippy (clippy::option_env_unwrap, two sites); that file is mainfix's and is not changed here.
No full workspace test run; Linux only; no Windows run of this change.
owner: linuxpub (Cursor agent on CachyOS Linux x86_64, CEO laptop)
provenance: The same module declarations exist, unlanded, as 7af0670b4 on local-agent/dot-fury-release-20261110 (dot-fury, T-DOTFURYXTASK-1). This commit is written independently on the CEO's instruction to publish the build fix first; a later merge of that branch conflicts only textually in main.rs.

results.before: cargo check -p xtask --bin xtask: exit 101, 17 errors E0433 (13 test_binary_evidence, 3 test_runner, 1 native_provenance). gate_receipt::tests::parse_binaries_reads_cwd_relative_running_paths failed in both binaries that mount gate_receipt.rs (left [] vs the two expected harnesses).
results.clippy: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p xtask --features release-tooling --bins --test git_publisher_native_hook -- -D warnings: exit 0; same with --profile test: exit 0
results.acceptance: gate_receipt filter: local-workflow 22 passed, xtask 21 passed, 0 failed
results.xtask_all_targets: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --features release-tooling --all-targets --no-fail-fast: 23 test binaries, 599 passed, 6 failed, 2 ignored, 56.1 s wall under load average ~30. All 6 failures are outside this change: local-workflow tests::disk_reclaim_frees_idle_caches_and_keeps_busy_and_current_ones (pre-existing intermittent), and dev_capacity tests in xtask/src/dev_capacity.rs (reached through bootstrap/susi-dev.rs by the susi-dev binary and tests/native_bootstrap.rs; neither mounts main.rs or gate_receipt.rs). The dev_capacity count varied between runs (1 then 5); that file is owned by agent mainfix.
